content:
pete.lowry said
Now (and before), which I double-click a message it opens in a new tab, but that tab does not show the folder pane, just the message (see the screen shot I posted).

Since Thunderbird has several update channels (release, esr, beta or Daily) it would be useful to mention the version you are using.

Your firstscreen shot shows several Inbox folders opened in tabs on the left ; of course the folder pane is displayed in the one you selected since this is a mail tab. You can open as many other folders as you like in new tabs and you'll always see the folder pane on the left.

But it is different for message tabs: your second screen shot shows a message opened in a tab, which doesn't show the folder pane. This is normal for message tabs as well as messages opened in new windows. As far as I can remember a double-click always opens a message in a new tab (or a new window), and in message tabs the folder pane has never been displayed.

I don't know any add-on or any userChrome.css tweak which would make this feature customisable.

content:
This is normal - AOL is just trying to re-authorize Thunderbird to manage your AOL email.

You should confirm that Cookies are allowed in Thunderbird ( see <Settings | Privacy & Security | Web Content | Accept cookies from sites>",) and it might help to delete any existing AOL cookies in Thunderbird (see <Settings | Privacy & Security | Web Content | Show cookies>".)

Then restart Thunderbird and supply your AOL credentials if prompted.
